summary.name: CircleCI Blog
summary.one_liner: The CircleCI blog index page, covering DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, and engineering productivity, listed under the Culture section of an SRE resource list.
use_cases: Keeping up with engineering productivity articles
summary.what_it_does: The page is the index of the CircleCI blog, showing a list of article read times and author names. The visible text includes a headline announcing CLI 1.0, which is described as built to unlock CI for humans and agents. The meta description says the blog covers DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, and engineering productivity, with tutorials, guides, and best practices. The specific article titled "Onboarding New Site Reliability Engineers" is not visible in the extracted text, so the page content does not confirm what that article says. Authors shown include Jacob Schmitt, Rob Zuber, Michael Webster, and Nick Smith.
notable: Lists CircleCI CLI 1.0, positioned for CI use by humans and agents
Covers DevOps, CI/CD, and engineering productivity topics
Articles include read-time estimates and named authors
caveats: The page text does not include the body of the SRE onboarding article, so its content is unverified
Page is a blog index rather than a tool page; product details are limited to a headline
